integrity: Equilibria and reproducibility calculations are derived from the published differential equations; no data-dependent or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact equilibrium census and local behavior at the rumor-free and one positive equilibrium only; no claim of bistability or a global dynamical classification.
The rates are mathematical examples, not calibrated interventions.
Full text of the 2008 saturated-recovery comparison was inaccessible; general prior implications may still require assessment.
title: Three equilibria below the rumor reproduction threshold in a saturated fact-checking model
